name: Gear and Accessories
description: Rings, necklaces, hats, gloves and more, worn beside armor in the Accessories screen.

pages.title: Gear and Accessories
pages.text: Besides armor you wear **accessories**: rings, necklaces, hats, gloves, belts and more. They all go in the one [#](7A3C9A)[Accessories](entry://glossary/curios)[#]() screen (**G**), so you wear gear on top of your armor.

Mods that make accessories:

- **Artifacts**: hats, shoes, gloves, belts, pendants
- **Iron's Spells**: rings, necklaces, spell books
- **The Aether**: rings, pendants, gloves, capes, a shield
- **Cataclysm**: amulets, belts, gloves, a ring
- **Critters and Companions**: pearl necklaces

pages.title: Cloud in a Bottle
pages.text: A double jump. One of the Artifacts items, found in loot rather than crafted.

pages.title: Snorkel
pages.text: Underwater breathing helper, with Flippers and Aqua-Dashers. See Diving Gear.

pages.title: Mimic
pages.text: Some chests are Mimics. Artifacts also spawn in underground camps and in loot.

Artifacts are mostly **found, not made**. Look in underground campsites, in chests and in Mimics.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Lootr](entry://exploration/lootr)[#]() gives each player their own loot. Water gear is covered in [#](2E5AAC)[Diving Gear](entry://ocean/diving)[#]().
